title: Windows Defender / Antivirus Blocking
description: Windows Defender or 3rd party antivirus flags or deletes the loader immediately.
solution:
1. Open Windows Security -> Virus & threat protection.
2. Click 'Manage settings' under Virus & threat protection settings.
3. Turn off Real-time protection, or scroll down to 'Exclusions' and add your Downloads/game folder as an exclusion.

title: Missing Visual C++ Redistributables
description: Loader crashes on launch or gives an error about missing MSVCP140.dll / VCRUNTIME140.dll.
solution: Install the All-in-One Visual C++ Runtime package from Microsoft to fix missing DLL dependencies.

title: DirectX Runtime Error
description: Overlay or menu doesn't show in-game due to missing DirectX runtime.
solution: Download and run the Microsoft DirectX End-User Runtime Web Installer.
